test.doc: Isolates the bench->DUT command path with no other deps: send PING on uart1, expect PONG. If THIS fails, the DUT is not receiving on uart1 RX (GPIO18) -- check the bench PA9 -> DUT GPIO18 wire and remove any leftover TestCases loopback jumpers (PA9<->PA3, PA2<->PA10). All other UART failures below are downstream of this.
